revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_005, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one premium collectible travel achievement medal for tier 5, ORANGE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "探险大师" (adventure master who somehow never pays). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 5 has an ornate refined circular medal with orange-gold enamel rim, thick layered gold metal, dramatic symmetrical side wings, crown-like top ornament, lower pedestal flourish, and a few small controlled white-gold light effects. It is more elaborate and warmer than tier 4, but slightly less overwhelming than final gold tier. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a cream-gold travel suitcase wearing a tiny toy-like jetpack backpack, leaning forward with confident explorer energy. The jetpack has simple glowing thrust shapes as light effects only; the suitcase remains dominant.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; tier 5 outer decoration large and dramatic, with slight safe padding; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: bold adventure comedy, orange rank warmth, premium glow, energetic but not chaotic.
Color palette: orange enamel rim, saturated gold metal, cream-gold suitcase, red-orange jetpack accents, white-gold glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy enamel, polished orange-gold metal, small metal jetpack, simple light effects, beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no globe, no mountains, no fireball, no explosion, no smoke cloud, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
title: 探险大师
concept: 橙金精致圆形加少量光效夸张修饰，中心为探险喷射背包旅行箱
integration_note: TripPet 1.0.8 travel medal redesign: six-level white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold rank progression; source PNG copied byte-identically to app-facing @3x PNG.
